I.businessIdea: BrightPath Consulting provides digital transformation and operations consulting for small-to-mid-sized businesses. We help companies streamline processes, adopt technology, and scale efficiently.
I.productServiceProblem: SMBs know they need digital transformation but can't afford big consulting firms. We provide expert consulting at SMB-friendly pricing.
I.businessModel: Project-based consulting (60%), monthly retainer contracts (30%), training workshops (10%).
I.oneYearGoals: 20 clients, $300K revenue, 3 case studies, and establish a referral pipeline.
I.threeYearGoals: $750K revenue, 50 clients, 2 consultants hired, and launch an online course division.
I.fiveYearGoals: $2M revenue, 10-person team, recognized regional consulting brand, and an online course platform generating passive income.
I.customerAcquisition: LinkedIn networking, content marketing (blog + newsletter), speaking at industry events, referrals, and partnerships with CPA firms.
I.targetMarket: SMBs with 10-200 employees in manufacturing, healthcare, and professional services. Revenue $2M-50M.
I.competition: Big firms (McKinsey, Deloitte) too expensive. Freelancers lack breadth. We offer professional-grade consulting at SMB pricing.
I.managementTeam: Founder has 15 years in operations and technology consulting, including 5 years at a Big 4 firm. Associate has 6 years in process improvement.
I.financialOutlook: Seeking $50K for marketing, tools, and working capital. Break-even by month 3, 35% profit margin (low overhead).
I.evidenceOfTraction: 3 signed clients before launch, 2 case studies from prior work, and a LinkedIn network of 8K+ connections in target industries.

II.companyDescription: BrightPath Consulting is a professional services firm helping SMBs navigate digital transformation, process improvement, and operational scaling. We bring Big 4 expertise at SMB-friendly prices.
II.missionStatement: To make expert consulting accessible to growing businesses, helping them transform operations and achieve sustainable scale.
II.coreValues: Expertise, integrity, pragmatism, and partnership. We deliver real results, not theoretical frameworks.
II.visionStatement: To be the trusted consulting partner for SMBs, known for practical expertise and measurable results.
II.shortTermObjectives: 20 clients, $300K revenue, 3 published case studies, and a referral pipeline generating 50% of new business.
II.longTermObjectives: $2M revenue, 10-person team, online course division, and regional brand recognition.
II.milestones:
1. Launch (month 1)
2. First 5 clients (month 3)
3. Break-even (month 3)
4. First case study (month 4)
5. $300K revenue run rate (month 12)
II.targetMarketSummary: SMBs (10-200 employees) in manufacturing, healthcare, and professional services needing digital transformation and process improvement.
II.industryContext: Consulting is a $250B US market. SMB consulting is the fastest-growing segment as digital transformation becomes essential.
II.competitiveLandscape: Big 4 firms serve enterprise. Freelancers serve micro-businesses. We serve the underserved mid-market.
II.businessStructure: LLC — pass-through taxation, liability protection. Single-member LLC.
II.ownershipInfo: 100% founder-owned. May offer equity to key hires as the team grows.

III.productDescription: Services: digital transformation assessment, process mapping and optimization, technology selection and implementation, change management, operational scaling, and executive coaching.
III.keySuppliers: Software vendors (we implement, not build), training platforms, and subcontractor network for specialized work.
III.problemSolved: SMBs need expert guidance to adopt technology and improve operations but can't afford Big 4 rates. We bridge the gap.
III.solution: Structured consulting engagements with clear deliverables, fixed-fee pricing, and practical implementation support — not just recommendations.
III.keyBenefits: Big 4 expertise, SMB-friendly pricing, fixed-fee engagements, hands-on implementation, and measurable outcomes.
III.competitiveAdvantage: 15 years of Big 4 experience applied to SMB problems, fixed-fee pricing (no open-ended billing), and implementation support (not just advice).
III.proprietaryFeatures: Proprietary assessment framework, a library of process templates, and a network of pre-vetted implementation partners.
III.pricingStrategy: Assessments: $5K-15K. Implementation projects: $20K-75K. Monthly retainers: $3K-8K. Workshops: $2K-5K.
III.positioningRationale: Mid-market: higher than freelancers, lower than Big 4. Value-based pricing aligned with client outcomes.
III.marginRationale: Primary cost is time. Bill rate $150-250/hr, effective cost $40-60/hr (including overhead). Gross margin 70-75%.
III.limitationsLiabilities: Client concentration risk, time-for-money model (scaling requires hiring), and dependency on the founder's expertise.
III.productionDelivery: On-site and remote consulting. Weekly working sessions, deliverable documents, and implementation support via video calls and email.
III.intellectualProperty: Proprietary assessment framework, process template library, and methodology documentation.
III.comprehensiveDescription: A consulting practice offering digital transformation, process improvement, and operational scaling services to SMBs, delivered through fixed-fee engagements and monthly retainers.

IV.industryOverview: US consulting is a $250B market. Management consulting grows 6% annually. The SMB segment is growing 12% as digital transformation becomes essential.
IV.industryTrends: Digital transformation is no longer optional. SMBs increasingly seek practical help, not theory. Fixed-fee pricing preferred. Remote consulting accepted.
IV.targetMarketSize: 200K+ SMBs with 10-200 employees in the region. 40% report needing consulting help with technology and operations.
IV.marketShareEstimate: Capture 0.01% of the addressable market — 50 clients generating $750K by year 3.
IV.customerNeeds: Practical expertise, affordable pricing, clear deliverables, hands-on implementation support, and measurable ROI.
IV.primaryResearch: Interviewed 50 SMB owners: 70% tried big consulting firms and found them too expensive, 85% want fixed-fee engagements, 60% need help with technology selection.
IV.secondaryResearch: Gartner reports SMB tech spending growing 8% annually. Deloitte study shows 60% of SMBs plan digital transformation initiatives in the next 2 years.
IV.barriersToEntry: Building credibility, client acquisition (long sales cycle), finding qualified associates, and competing with established firms.
IV.barrierStrategies: Leverage founder's Big 4 credentials, content marketing to build authority, start with referral network, and hire experienced associates as revenue grows.
IV.swotStrengths: Big 4 expertise, proprietary framework, fixed-fee model, strong network, low overhead.
IV.swotWeaknesses: New brand, founder dependency, limited capacity (time-for-money), no team yet.
IV.swotOpportunities: Growing SMB market, online courses, productized services, team scaling, partnerships with CPA firms.
IV.swotThreats: Economic downturn (consulting is discretionary), competition from larger firms moving downmarket, AI tools reducing demand.
IV.swotActionPlan: Use content to build authority. Productize services to reduce time-for-money dependency. Hire associates to scale capacity.
IV.swotImmediateGoals: Sign 5 clients, publish first case study, build referral pipeline, achieve $25K monthly revenue.
IV.swotLongTermGoals: $2M revenue, 10-person team, online course platform, recognized brand.
IV.regulatoryChanges: No significant regulatory changes. Professional liability insurance essential.
IV.technologyShifts: AI tools are automating some consulting tasks but also creating new advisory opportunities. Remote consulting is now accepted.
IV.economicConditions: Consulting is discretionary but digital transformation is increasingly seen as essential. Recession may actually help as companies need efficiency.
IV.industryEvolution: Productized consulting, subscription models, and online education are transforming the industry. Pure advisory is giving way to implementation support.

V.productionProcess: Engagement flow: discovery call → proposal → contract → assessment → findings report → implementation plan → execution → review. 4-12 week typical engagement.
V.productionMethods: Client interviews, process mapping workshops, technology audits, data analysis, and structured frameworks.
V.unitEconomics: Average project: $35K. Time investment: 80 hours. Effective rate: $437/hr. Overhead: $60/hr. Margin: 85%.
V.qualityControl: Client satisfaction surveys, engagement reviews, peer review of deliverables, and outcome tracking against KPIs.
V.commercialAccessibility: Co-working space with meeting rooms, parking, and transit access
V.commercialCosts: Co-working membership: $500/month. Client meeting expenses: $300/month. Home office for admin work.
V.legalLicensesPermits: Business license obtained. No special permits required for consulting.
V.legalIP: Proprietary assessment framework protected as trade secret. Trademark for business name filed.
V.legalInsurance: Professional liability (E&O) $2M coverage, general liability. Estimated $3.5K/year.
V.legalRegulations: Standard business regulations. Professional liability for advisory services. Data privacy for client information.

VI.ownerBios: Founder: MBA, 15 years consulting, Big 4 experience, Lean Six Sigma Black Belt.

VI.orgChart: Owner → Associate (client work) + Virtual Assistant (admin) → Future: Senior Consultant, Marketing Manager

VIII.pnlAssumptions: 20 engagements averaging $15K. Retainer clients: 3 at $5K/month. Direct cost: associate + tools. Overhead: low (co-working).
VIII.threeYearPnLNotes: Year 2: hire senior consultant, add retainer clients. Year 3: 2 consultants, online course pilot.
VIII.cashFlowAssumptions: Clients pay 50% upfront, 50% on completion. Retainers billed monthly. Expenses paid monthly.

IX.additionalDetails: Professional liability insurance maintained. Client confidentiality agreements standard. All consultants bound by NDA.
IX.dataPrivacyPolicy: Client data stored securely with encryption. No client data shared without consent. GDPR/CCPA compliant practices.

X.howInvestmentStrengthens: Provides a buffer during the client acquisition phase and funds marketing to build the pipeline faster.
X.proposedRepaymentTerms: Revolving line of credit at 7%. Interest-only payments on drawn balance.
X.collateralExistingLiens: No collateral required (unsecured line based on founder credit). No existing liens.
X.capitalNeededNow: $30K now. May seek $200K in Year 2 for team expansion.
X.fundDeploymentGrowthPlan: Months 1-3: acquire first 5 clients. Month 3: break-even. Month 6: hire associate. Year 2: senior consultant + online course pilot.
X.projectedROI: Year 1: 350% return on $30K investment (low capital, high margin). Year 3: 1000%+ cumulative.
X.exitStrategy: Build to a sellable consulting practice, or transition to a productized services + online education model for passive income.
X.ownershipOffered: Not offering equity currently. May offer equity to key hires as team grows.
X.milestonesConditions: Break-even month 3. 20 clients by month 12. $300K revenue year 1. 3 case studies published.
X.financialReporting: Monthly P&L, quarterly reviews, annual tax prep. Line of credit reviewed annually by bank.
X.investorInvolvement: N/A — line of credit, not equity. Founder maintains full control.

X.physicalPlantLocation: Co-working space membership with meeting room access. Home office for administrative work.
